{{Top}}
'''Dressings''' was a type of [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] that was added to various [[Salad/Legends|salads]].<ref name="Menu">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}}</ref> At some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]],<ref name="DexDates">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}} is set at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]] per the {{DiningAtDexDate}}.</ref> [[Luptoomian dressing]] and [[Meerian vinaigrette]] were both varieties of dressings used on salads at [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Menu" />
